usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover which ACME challenge plugin types are available on the PDM instance and what configuration parameters each plugin expects. The returned schema objects are used as a reference when creating or updating ACME plugins via the config/acme/plugins endpoints — match the plugin `id` and populate fields according to the `schema` object. No authentication privileges beyond a valid API token are required (user: all).

examples.summary: List all available ACME challenge plugin schemas

tips: The `schema` property within each item uses additionalProperties:true, so the shape varies per plugin type (e.g., dns-01 plugins expose provider-specific credential fields).
Cross-reference the returned `id` values with existing plugin configurations from get_config_acme_plugins to identify which schemas are already in use.
This endpoint is safe to call unauthenticated in practice (user: all), making it suitable for pre-flight checks before presenting a plugin-creation UI.
